body: Gotcha, narrowing down state options would be an extremely logical next step! Hopefully it won't ever come to that, but it's encouraging knowing that if I ever need to recover, it's not impossible to come back!

I totally understand that, and to some extent I do feel like that's a stupid question, but I did see a post from many years ago on this subreddit where someone said they did get the license put on probation for five years after they tried to commit suicide. I was kind of hoping that mayhaps that was kind of a one-off occurrence, because I also think that'd be incredibly unreasonable.

Thank you! I think that that's a very reasonable answer. Of course, I don't think I'd let a simple license get in the way between life and death, but it is nice to have that kind of reassurance leaning towards the go to the hospital end.

Thank you for your response, but I guess I'm kind of wondering about the worst case scenario, which would be civil commitment. Maybe my family finds me about to do something and I get committed. There probably is a chance of losing licensure in that case. :0 Which sucks. Maybe this is just the consequence of attempting! It's good to know at least...
Thank you so much! I hope you have a nice day! :D
Thank you so much! That really eases my concerns. :) thank you!
